Review for Dr. Dream:
I consulted with Dr. Dream about my dental crown, which I had done almost 20 years ago. The original crown's color had changed, and my gums were dark from the old material. After the consultation, I explained my needs to Dr. Dream, and she clearly outlined the treatment plan. I was very impressed. I didn't expect such a significant change after the procedure. Dr. Dream was attentive throughout the treatment, constantly asking if I had any further questions. She designed the crown's shape to complement my face until I was satisfied. The price was as agreed upon, with no hidden charges. I would give her a perfect score of 100 out of 1000!
Thank you so much, Dr. Dream!

The receptionist was very professional and friendly, and communicated fluently in Chinese. I would recommend this place to any Chinese person who needs dental care. The environment is comfortable and clean, and the dentist's technique was gentle during the cleaning. It was a great experience and highly recommended. I will definitely come back next time I need a cleaning. I've saved the address! 🥰

我牙疼了三天，来到这里，这里有很好的环境，也有中文翻译。这里的医生先咨询了我的病情并询问了我有没有过敏物质，然后又给我测量了体温和血压。之后开始给我检查牙齿（用了X光)，最终是我的智齿有问题，最后把我的两颗智齿拔了。医生有10多年的经验，手术过程很轻松，不会感觉到疼痛。这里的收费也不贵，拍片+拔牙(两颗)一共6000泰铢。
在泰国的中国伙伴如果遇到牙齿问题，推荐来这里试试。
